verdict.rationale: Relay documents automated transfer rules that split deposits across up to 20 accounts by dollar amount or percentage, and that sweep excess operating cash into savings. A community user confirms the automatic partitioning works. However, nothing in the pack shows threshold-triggered top-ups into an account running low, or low-balance alerts, so only the auto-transfer half of the story is covered. Missing for 10: balance-triggered auto top-up between accounts, low-balance alerts/notifications, hands-on evidence of rule configuration.
